retainedReference.reason: No unique physical footprint or centerline with exact Wikidata identity has been resolved.

pictures.author: Ekrem Canli
pictures.observations: Entire960x640 front gateway picture inspected. Tall ochre/red/cream ornate facade, open rounded stone arch, blue-green panel borders, narrow triple gray swept roof crests, red flanking pillars/walls, short stair approach and stone guardian lions. Painted narratives/text are not copied; original simplified panel/scroll vocabulary is used.

pictures.author: Wang Quanchao / Xinhua
pictures.license: Copyright reference viewed only; no pixels copied
pictures.observations: Entire900x600 close aerial inspected. Multiple connected gray swept tile roof groups around a large tree-filled main court and a smaller eastern green court; northern irregular U/L gallery groups, pale and red walls, a separate white taller hall, island trees/shore/water. First wider900x600 aerial established island context but did not resolve roof layout; the close aerial filled that specific coverage gap. Courtyard/roof and gateway allocation within the mapped envelopes remains approximate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Baidicheng core: eight named mapped hall/temple footprints articulated into gray swept tile roof ranges, open main/eastern courts, a taller White House, northern U/L exhibition ranges and an ochre/red decorated Baidi gateway with a real rounded arch, triple roof crests, original simplified painted-panel/scroll vocabulary, stairs and two simplified stone guardians. Island landform, trees, shoreline, bridge, external paths and independent buildings remain host context. No complete ancient fortress restoration, copied text/narrative painting or museum interior.
